title: Hemolux: Non-Invasive Conjunctival Pallor Screening with Fairness-Audited Selective Prediction
description: Hemolux is an edge-native, zero-cloud non-invasive conjunctival pallor screening system engineered for low-resource smartphone environments. It features an ordinal regression architecture, calibrated selective prediction (abstaining under adverse optical conditions), and comprehensive fairness auditing across skin phototypes (Individual Typology Angle).
